title: The exit
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, empty American highway at night, headlight glare on wet asphalt, deep navy darkness with amber and vivid yellow accents, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. She told me to take the exit. Now I owe her a ride. 🌧️

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Ray picked up the woman in the yellow raincoat. She knew his daughter's name.
scenes.image: a young woman in a yellow raincoat in a truck passenger seat at night, staring at the road

scenes.narration: The exit came up out of the dark. Exit forty-one. She said it quietly. Take it.
scenes.image: a dark highway at night, an off-ramp curving away into thick fog, lit by truck headlights

scenes.narration: Ray's whole route went the other way. Two hundred miles of interstate, on schedule. Every instinct said keep going.
scenes.image: a trucker's hand hovering over the turn signal lever, the highway splitting ahead in the rain

scenes.narration: She didn't argue. She just looked at him. Ray. Please. He turned the wheel.
scenes.image: a big rig leaning into a foggy off-ramp at night, headlights sweeping across wet guardrails

scenes.narration: The ramp curved down into fog. He stopped at the bottom. Behind them, up on the interstate, he heard it. Brakes. Glass. Metal folding into metal.
scenes.image: a parked semi truck at the bottom of a foggy ramp, distant glow and smoke rising from the highway above

scenes.narration: Black ice on the overpass. Eleven vehicles. One mile ahead. Right where his truck would have been in sixty seconds.
scenes.image: a distant highway overpass in fog at night, flashing red and blue emergency lights, no people visible

scenes.narration: Nobody in a truck cab walks away from a pileup like that, the trooper told him later. Nobody.
scenes.image: a state trooper in a rain jacket standing by a patrol car at dawn, looking up at a fogged overpass

scenes.narration: Ray turned to thank her. The seat was empty. The yellow raincoat lay folded on it, neat as a gift. Still dripping.
scenes.image: a neatly folded yellow raincoat on an empty truck passenger seat, water dripping onto the floor

scenes.narration: Then, from the dark sleeper cab behind him, her voice. Calm. Closer than before. I got you home, Ray. Now you owe me a ride.
scenes.image: the dark curtained sleeper cab behind a truck's seats, a faint pale shape in the shadow

scenes.narration: Tomorrow night: a night guard, a twelve-floor office tower, and an elevator button for floor thirteen.
scenes.image: an empty office lobby at night, brass elevator doors, a single button glowing on the panel
